objectives: Students will demonstrate a fundamental understanding of the origins, concepts, and definition of systems engineering.
Students will demonstrate a fundamental understanding of the major phases of systems engineering (such as integration, functional analysis, requirement development, optimization, design, life cycle).
Students will demonstrate an understanding of how measures of effectiveness can be used in evaluating alternative system designs with respect to system requirements and specifications.
Students will demonstrate an understanding of the need for models for economic evaluation of systems.
Students will work in teams to solve complex problems.
Students will write professional quality reports.
